title: VenoStent Enters Health Wildcatters Accelerator
body_markdown:
VenoStent was accepted into and began its participation at the exceptional[HealthWildcatters](https://www.healthwildcatters.com/) accelerator program in Dallas. We're extremely excited to be involved with such a fabulous network of mentors, leaders, angels, and experts in all areas of healthcare delivery.


This is definitely the start of something beautiful.
